fullPassage: When people are asked what any painting hanging on a gallery wall means, no matter how strange it might appear, as is the case with most abstract-expressionist paintings, they tend to find meaning in it because it is located in a gallery. Consider a soda can found thrown away on a city street. If we were to come across this item on the street, we would no doubt view it as a piece of garbage or rubbish. But if we saw the very same object on a pedestal, displayed in an art gallery, signed by some artist, and given a title such as "Waste," then we would interpret its meaning in a vastly different way. We would, in fact, be inclined to interpret it as an artistic form, descrying a throw-away or materialistic society. Clearly, the can's location on a sidewalk versus its display on a pedestal in an art gallery will influence how we will interpret it.

But if we saw the very same object on a pedestal, displayed in an art gallery, signed by some artist, and ③<u>gave</u> a title such as "Waste," then we would interpret its meaning in a vastly different way. Clearly, the can's location on a sidewalk versus its display on a pedestal will ④<u>influence</u> how we will interpret it.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: object는 제목이 주어진(given) 대상이므로 수동의 과거분사 given이 필요하다. gave(과거형, 능동)는 틀림. signed, displayed와 병렬 구조.
det.analysis:
✅ ① is: as is the case 관용구 적절
✅ ② found: 과거분사 (수동) 적절
❌ ③ gave → given: signed, displayed, given 병렬 구조에서 수동 과거분사 필요
✅ ④ influence: will + 원형 적절
det.tip: displayed / signed / given — 모두 과거분사 병렬

Consider a soda can found thrown away on a city street. If we were to come across this item on the street, we would no doubt view it as a piece of garbage or rubbish. But if we saw the very same object on a pedestal, displayed in an art gallery, signed by some artist, and given a title such as "Waste," then we would __________ its meaning in a vastly different way.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 미술관에서 보면 그 의미를 매우 다른 방식으로 해석한다(interpret)는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ interpret: 해석하다 — 원문과 일치
❌ ① ignore: 무시하다
❌ ② destroy: 파괴하다
❌ ③ forget: 잊다
det.tip: interpret = 해석하다, 풀이하다

questions.passage: When people are asked what any painting hanging on a gallery wall means, no matter how strange it might appear, as is the case with most abstract-expressionist paintings, they tend to find meaning in it because it is located in a gallery. Consider a soda can found thrown away on a city street. If we were to come across this item on the street, we would no doubt view it as a piece of garbage or rubbish. But if we saw the very same object on a pedestal, displayed in an art gallery, signed by some artist, and given a title such as "Waste," then we would interpret its meaning in a vastly different way. We would, in fact, be inclined to interpret it as an artistic form, descrying a throw-away or materialistic society. Clearly, the can's location on a sidewalk versus its display on a pedestal in an art gallery will influence how we will interpret it.
questions.stem: 이 글에서 소다 캔에 주어진 제목(title)을 영어로 쓰시오.

det.korean: 소다 캔에 "Waste"라는 제목이 붙여졌다.
det.analysis: given a title such as "Waste" → 제목은 Waste
det.tip: Waste = 폐기물, 낭비

questions.stem: 이 글에서 소다 캔의 예시가 사용된 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소다 캔이 길에서는 쓰레기, 미술관에서는 예술로 해석되는 예시를 통해 위치가 해석에 영향을 미침을 보여준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 위치가 물체 해석에 미치는 영향을 구체적으로 보여주기 위해
❌ ② 환경오염의 심각성을 경고하기 위해
❌ ③ 미술관의 전시 방법을 설명하기 위해
❌ ④ 소다 캔의 재활용 과정을 설명하기 위해
det.tip: 소다 캔 = 위치에 따른 해석 변화를 보여주는 구체적 사례

ch: 위치가 물체 해석에 미치는 영향을 보여주기 위해

questions.stem: 위 문장에서 <u>how</u>의 문법적 역할로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: how는 influence의 목적어인 간접의문문(명사절)을 이끄는 의문부사이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 간접의문문을 이끄는 의문부사
❌ ① 양보부사절 접속사 (however의 역할)
❌ ③ 관계부사 (선행사 + how가 아님)
❌ ④ 감탄문의 how (감탄 아님)
det.tip: influence + how절 = ~하는 방법에 영향을 미치다 (간접의문문)
